item.title: Version 1.5.0
item.description:
Added

  • With the Dock always shown, the living snowman now performs on top of the Dock instead of hiding behind it. It leaves by jumping off.
  • Snow slowly thaws once it stops snowing, so it never covers the screen for good.
  • "Hide from screenshots and sharing": the weather stays on screen but is left out of screenshots, recordings and calls.
  • "Falls in front of windows": the weather can fall over app windows too.
  • Russian interface.
  • First-run tips. The "?" in the panel shows them again.
  • The temperature outside next to the menu bar icon while "Match the weather outside" is on (can be turned off).

    • Fixed

  • Snow no longer seems to lie on the menu bar. Windows tucked right under it don't grow drifts.
  • The panel fits on small screens (it scrolls when needed), and Russian labels are no longer cut off.

item.title: Version 1.4.1
item.description:
Fixed

  • Everything felt sluggish: the weather layers redrew far more often than needed (on two displays, six full-screen layers at 60 fps). Now each layer redraws only when its own content changes. Snow and leaves run at 30 fps, which looks the same, and only rain and hail use the full rate.
  • No more snow on the menu bar.
  • Snow on windows no longer starts as a row of "pixels": snowfall varies smoothly along the edge, and a fresh dusting fades in.

item.title: Version 1.4.0
item.description:
Fixed

  • **Important:** with sound on, after about 20 seconds of snow every app on the Mac could go silent. If that happened, quit Weatherpane. This version fixes it.
  • Sounds were too quiet to hear on laptop speakers.
  • "Match the weather outside" now applies the city as you type, and says what it is showing.
  • The Dock: ground snow now lies on the desktop itself, so the Dock (shown or auto-hidden) and windows cover it naturally.
  • Mission Control and Exposé no longer stutter: the weather steps aside while they're open.
  • The cursor touches only the snow it's actually in. Working in a title bar or dragging no longer erodes drifts.
  • Shaking a window shakes its snow off. Dragging a snowy window is smooth.
  • Hail looks like ice and moves smoothly. 60 fps is the new default; 30 is the battery option.
  • Leaves left after autumn get buried by snow.

    • Added

  • Gusty wind: natural swells and gusts on top of your setting or the real wind.
  • A window dragged into another window's snow bulldozes it off.
  • The living snowman got a scarf, a proper hat, twig arms with elbows, blinking, eyes that follow the cursor, squash and stretch, and a jump when clicked.
  • "Build one" makes the snowman come right away. On its own it appears rarely (every 10–40 minutes, only when there's snow).

item.title: Version 1.3.0
item.description:
Added

  • Autumn: small maple leaves tumble down, and a few settle on windows and the Dock. The cursor blows them away.
  • "Match the weather outside": real conditions for your city or location, from MET Norway.
  • The Dock gets its own snow cap. With an auto-hidden Dock, the ground snow gets out of the way when it slides up.
  • In-app updates: the app checks once a day, or click the version number in the menu.
  • A redrawn lion cub mascot: sits and looks at you, then runs.
  • Licensing groundwork: trial, key activation for 3 Macs. Not enforced yet.

    • Changed

  • The cursor brushes snow softly: it pushes it into a little ridge and lifts powder, instead of cutting holes.
  • Window snow is thinner and lumpier, lit by its slope, with a soft shadow on the title bar.
  • The snowman is smaller. Low intensity is now a genuine drizzle or a few flakes.

    • Fixed

  • Snow on a rounded window corner could be drawn over a window in front of it.
  • Hand-built snowmen didn't melt in the rain.
  • Menu bar frost was drawn as a dark line.
